== Airlines and destinations ==
[[File:Puerto vallarta aeropuerto 5.jpg|thumb|Alaska Airlines Boeing B737 at PVR]]
Intense seasonal tourism to Puerto Vallarta means that passenger traffic at the airport is notably focused on flights to the United States and Canada. Among the busiest routes at the airport are those to [[Los Angeles International Airport|Los Angeles]], [[Dallas Fort Worth International Airport|Dallas]], and [[Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport|Phoenix]]. [[WestJet]] stands out as the airline serving the largest number of destinations, connecting Puerto Vallarta with 12 Canadian airports during the high season.
